patch_description: Improves the ansatz block by (1) heavily sharing rotation parameters across qubits using an even/odd pattern (dramatically reducing total trainable circuit parameters, improving parameter efficiency), and (2) using a structured, repeatable cube/hypercube CZ entangling scheme plus alternating RY/RX/Z-phase refinement to preserve classification accuracy under the fixed re-uploading + Z-readout pipeline. No changes are made to the fixed training loop, feature map, re-uploading schedule, measurements, or hyperparameters—only EVOLVE-BLOCK ANSATZ_SPEC is replaced.
